description: This is a PHP source file defining a class named PaymentMethod within the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Model.Checkout. The class extends a Controller class from the Opencart System Engine and provides functionality to retrieve available payment methods based on the provided payment address, by loading and querying extension models.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: A class that manages available payment methods for checkout based on active extensions and configuration states.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active payment methods applicable to the provided payment address by querying the extension models and filtering based on configuration status.
